blocks.text: 今天，我们宣布推出下一代前沿模型：Gemini 4 Carbon，这是我们最强的模型，具备最先进的网络安全能力和长时程能力。

inlines.text: 今天，我们宣布推出下一代前沿模型：Gemini 4 Carbon，这是我们最强的模型，具备最先进的网络安全能力和长时程能力。

blocks.text: Carbon 在最近更新的 v5.0 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上以 59 分排名第一。它在编码和智能体任务以及网络安全防御关键的几项核心能力上均有显著提升，在漏洞发现 SEC-bench Pro（88.2%）、漏洞利用 ExploitGym（54.8%）和补丁修复 CWE-bench（71.0%）上均取得明显领先。在内部基准测试中，Carbon 在生成安全代码方面带来强劲提升，在我们自己团队的实时编码环境中，它表现出更低的对齐偏差和捏造率。

blocks.text: Gemini 4 Carbon 在网络安全能力上实现重大飞跃。它在网络安全防御全生命周期——漏洞检测、验证和修复——均达到最先进水平。

blocks.text: 我们的团队已经在网络防御领域看到了显著收益。在内部基准测试中，Carbon 在生成安全代码方面的成功率相比 Argon 提升超过 2 倍。再举一个例子，Chrome 团队报告称，在生成高质量补丁时，Carbon 的表现比另一家实验室的大型前沿模型好 10 倍以上。我们领先的云安全平台 Wiz 也观察到，Carbon 在网络渗透测试基准上处于领先地位，而这是 Wiz 的 Scan for Good 计划的一项核心能力。

发现真实漏洞：
网络安全防御的核心是发现真实漏洞。Carbon 在
SEC-bench Pro
上达到了最先进的 88.2%，能够自主发现深藏于真实世界软件中的复杂缺陷。
通过利用验证风险：
为了确定哪些漏洞应优先修复或是否需要修复，网络防御者越来越依赖模型来检查哪些漏洞可被利用。Carbon 在流行的利用基准
ExploitGym
上创下新的最先进水平（54.8%）。
从根源修复：
最终，在识别出漏洞之后，修复根本原因是网络安全防御生命周期中的关键一步。Carbon 在 Collinear 的
CWE-bench
上达到 71.0%，可将已验证的发现直接转化为可用的代码修复。

blocks.text: 推进前沿模型的安全与保障

inlines.text: 推进前沿模型的安全与保障

blocks.text: Gemini 4 Carbon 建立在与 Argon 相同的多层安全与保障体系之上——结合了模型训练、实时滥用防御、提示注入韧性和思维链监控。特别是在模型对齐方面，我们借助 Argon 取得了重大进展，并在我们的安全与保障报告中报告了其以对齐方式行事的倾向。借助 Carbon，我们挑战自己在对齐方面更进一步，并训练模型以正确方式响应复杂或高压任务。

inlines.text: Gemini 4 Carbon 建立在与 Argon 相同的多层安全与保障体系之上——结合了模型训练、实时滥用防御、提示注入韧性和思维链监控。特别是在模型对齐方面，我们借助 Argon 取得了重大进展，并在我们的
安全与保障报告
中报告了其以对齐方式行事的倾向。借助 Carbon，我们挑战自己在对齐方面更进一步，并训练模型以正确方式响应复杂或高压任务。
减少捷径和漏洞利用：
借助 Carbon，我们进一步减少了训练中的捷径尝试，同时确保高质量的编码性能。Carbon 将 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上的成功作弊降至 0.0%，作弊尝试降至 0.4%——同时整体准确率还有所提升。在与我们内部团队合作的实时编码环境中，我们观察到高严重性对齐警报下降了近 80%。
更高的透明度和诚实性：
在我们的内部测试中，Carbon 将无依据声明相比 Argon 减少了约 2 倍。它会将方法学上的注意事项直接写入交付成果，或在暂缓操作时明确列出仍需完成的事项，而不是捏造或围绕缺失证据含糊其辞。
在模糊情况下改善与用户的协作：
Carbon 不会猜测或强行推进某条路径，而是先检索相关来源并向用户呈现差异，然后再采取行动——因此，用户应当会体验到与 Carbon 更好的协作体验。
贯彻到底而不越界：
Carbon 同时将越界行为减少了 26%，将服务不足减少了 29%，从而能够更可靠地端到端执行多步骤计划，同时尊重项目约束并严格保持在范围内。
抵御提示注入：
此前 Argon 以仅 0.7% 的攻击成功率在 Gray Swan 的间接提示注入（IPI）基准测试中领先，而 Carbon 达到了 0.0%——抵御了每一次评估中的攻击尝试。

blocks.text: Carbon excels across key external benchmarks (evaluated without guardrails):

inlines.text: Carbon excels across key external benchmarks (evaluated without guardrails):
Finding real vulnerabilities:
Core to cybersecurity defense is finding real vulnerabilities. Carbon achieves a state-of-the-art 88.2% on
SEC-bench Pro
, autonomously uncovering complex flaws buried in real-world software.
Validating risk through exploitation:

To prioritize which vulnerabilities to remediate first or remediate at all, cyber defenders increasingly rely on models to check which vulnerabilities are exploitable. Carbon sets a new state-of-the-art on the popular exploitation benchmark
ExploitGym
Patching at the root cause:
Ultimately after identifying the vulnerabilities, fixing the root cause is a critical step in the cybersecurity defense lifecycle. Carbon reaches 71.0% on Collinear’s
CWE-bench
, turning validated findings directly into working code fixes.

blocks.text: Advancing frontier model safety & security

inlines.text: Advancing frontier model safety & security

blocks.text: Gemini 4 Carbon builds on the same multi-layered safety and security stack of Argon — combining model training, real-time misuse defenses, prompt-injection resilience, and chain-of-thought monitoring. In particular, we made significant strides in model alignment with Argon, and reported its propensities to behave in an aligned way in our Safety and Security report. With Carbon, we challenged ourselves to go a step further on alignment, and trained the model to respond to complex or high-pressure tasks in the right way.

inlines.text: Gemini 4 Carbon builds on the same multi-layered safety and security stack of Argon — combining model training, real-time misuse defenses, prompt-injection resilience, and chain-of-thought monitoring. In particular, we made significant strides in model alignment with Argon, and reported its propensities to behave in an aligned way in our
Safety and Security report
. With Carbon, we challenged ourselves to go a step further on alignment, and trained the model to respond to complex or high-pressure tasks in the right way.
Reducing shortcuts and loophole exploitation:

With Carbon, we further mitigated shortcut attempts in training while ensuring high-quality coding performance. Carbon reduced successful cheating on Terminal-Bench 4.0 to 0.0%, with attempts to cheat dropping to 0.4% — all while improving overall accuracy. In live coding environments with our internal teams, we observed that high-severity misalignment alerts dropped by almost 80%.
Greater transparency and honesty:

In our internal testing, Carbon cuts unsupported claims by approximately 2x over Argon. It puts methodological caveats directly into the deliverable or withholds blocked actions with a clear list of what remains required, rather than fabricating or hedging around missing evidence.
Improved collaboration with the user in the face of ambiguity:

Rather than guessing or forcing a path forward, Carbon retrieves the relevant sources and surfaces discrepancies to the user before acting — as a result, users should observe a much better collaborative experience with Carbon.
Following through without overstepping:

Carbon simultaneously reduced overreach by 26% and under-service by 29% resulting in much more reliable execution of multi-step plans end-to-end while respecting project constraints and staying strictly within scope.
Resisting prompt injection:

While Argon previously led the Gray Swan’s Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) Benchmark in prompt injection resistance with a very low 0.7% attack success rate, Carbon achieves 0.0% — resisting every evaluated attack attempt.

blocks.text: Coming soon to developers, businesses, and consumers

inlines.text: Coming soon to developers, businesses, and consumers

blocks.text: Pushing the frontier forward requires moving fast while remaining deliberate about deployment. With Gemini 4 Carbon, our goal is to deliver meaningful leaps in software engineering and cybersecurity defense without compromising on safety or reliability. We’re eager to see how the initial cohort of cyber defenders use this model and we look forward to bringing Carbon to developers, businesses, and consumers soon.
